title: 015 关押死伤016 邪异物子器
content_zh:
冰冷的直面刮刀迎头袭来，寒光印入眼帘，刀锋在眼瞳放大。
许临东毫不犹豫，抬手低喝，掌心“呼”
地腾起金红灶火。
“啪！”
他反应极快，出手精准，一把攥住女子握刀的手腕。
一股刺骨阴冷顺着接触处蔓延而来，掌心的灶火顿时剧烈摇晃，几近熄灭。
更令人心惊的是，那纤细手臂中传来的力量竟大得不可思议。
许临东果断松开了油门，双手齐出，右手的掌心灶火轰然暴燃，狠狠打在女子的胸口。
“轰！”
紧接着，汹涌火光瞬间吞没女子手臂。
四周浓烟滚滚卷来，如影随形，协同着一起驱邪。
他右手一把握住了那柄邪异物刮面直刀冰冷的刀柄。
仿佛是岩浆滚入了冰山里。
刹那间，他的双手金红灶火齐齐黯淡，几近熄灭。
一股直刺心灵的邪恶与阴冷气息扑面袭来。
他感觉上半身几乎都要冻僵了，思维也好似受到了邪恶的侵袭。
但他却在此时咬牙，发出一声低沉怒喝：
“关押！”
他那颈前躁动到了极点的通天塔骤然亮起微光，大量功德消耗了下去。
第三层塔身仿佛有门扉洞开。

好似一个早已等候了多久的巨兽张开了嘴巴，迫不及待吞下美味的食物。
下一秒，那被他紧握在手中的邪异物刮面直刀凭空消失。
那道纠缠于摩托间的曼妙女子的扭曲身影，也几乎在同一瞬间，化作黑雾诡异消散了。
“功德+650！”
邪异物，被通天塔成功关押！
“嗤轰！”
重型摩托的烟囱尾气管仿佛失去了力气正在吐口水的蛤蟆，抖动着吐出了两个烟圈。
周围的阴影黑雾顿时迅速散去，显露出四周空旷的马路和不远处的公园。
在公园那里，他看到了一道熟悉的倩影向着这边狂奔而来，神色焦急悲切。
“浔姐？”
许临东强忍双眼灼痛，拧紧油门冲了过去。
他下意识回头，只见身后笼罩的大片黑雾正在缓缓散去。
远处雾中，还隐隐传来打斗声、火光迸溅的炸响，以及地面剧烈震颤的闷响。
随着这些动静持续传来，黑雾退散的速度明显加快。
许临东心头骤然一紧。
content_en:
The cold scraper hit him head-on, the cold light entered his eyes, and the blade of the blade dilated in his pupils.
Xu Lindong did not hesitate, raised his hand and shouted low, "calling" with his palm
A golden and red stove fire rises from the ground.
"Crack!"
He reacted very quickly and struck accurately, grabbing the woman's knife-holding wrist.
A biting coldness spread along the contact point, and the stove fire in the palm suddenly shook violently and almost went out.
What's even more shocking is that the power coming from that slender arm is incredibly powerful.
Xu Lindong decisively released the accelerator, stretched out his hands, and the stove flame burst out in the palm of his right hand, hitting the woman's chest hard.
"Boom!"
Immediately afterwards, the raging fire instantly engulfed the woman's arm.
Thick smoke billows from all around, following each other like a shadow, working together to drive away evil spirits.
With his right hand, he grasped the cold handle of the evil foreign body scraping straight knife.
It was as if magma had rolled into the iceberg.
In an instant, the golden and red stove flames in his hands dimmed and almost went out.
An evil and cold aura that pierced the soul hit his face.
His upper body felt almost frozen, and his mind seemed to be invaded by evil.
But at this moment, he gritted his teeth and let out a low roar:
"Detention!"
The Babel Tower in front of his neck, which was extremely restless, suddenly lit up with a faint light, and a lot of merit was consumed.
The tower on the third floor seems to have a door opening.
It was like a giant beast that had been waiting for a long time opened its mouth and couldn't wait to swallow the delicious food.
The next second, the evil foreign object straight knife that was held tightly in his hand disappeared out of thin air.
The twisted figure of the graceful woman entangled between the motorcycles turned into black mist and mysteriously disappeared at almost the same instant.
"Merit +650!"
The evil foreign object was successfully imprisoned by the Tower of Babel!
"Chi Boom!"
The chimney exhaust pipe of the heavy motorcycle seemed like a toad that had lost its strength and was spitting, shaking and spitting out two smoke rings.
The surrounding shadows and black fog quickly dissipated, revealing the surrounding empty roads and the park not far away.
In the park, he saw a familiar figure running towards this side, looking anxious and sad.
"Sister Xun?"
Xu Lindong endured the burning pain in his eyes, tightened the accelerator and rushed over.
He subconsciously turned around and saw that the large black fog shrouding behind him was slowly dissipating.
In the distant fog, there were also faint sounds of fighting, explosions of fire, and the muffled sound of violent shaking on the ground.
As these movements continued, the black fog retreated significantly faster.
Xu Lindong's heart suddenly tightened.
